original_issue.title: Hero subtitle collides with primary action button
original_issue.description: Negative margin causes subtitle text to collide with and obscure the top of the CTA button.

suggested_fix.explanation: Normalizes bottom margin to 24px and line-height to 1.4, removing overlap with the CTA button.

verification_reason: Browser automation error: Failed to launch Playwright browser: No module named 'playwright'

metadata.runtime_dom_only_note: IMPORTANT ARCHITECTURAL NOTE: The CSS fix was injected into the browser DOM in-memory at runtime via Playwright.
